title: Music scorer (beat-grid music and in-key cue sounds)
what_it_does: Composes a music bed and cue sounds from a list of cut times, on one beat grid, in one key, in one reverb room, and writes a WAV.
when_to_use: Every video that has sound: it replaces asking the person for music. Pick the palette per brand (nylon, felt-piano, marimba, kalimba or soft-synth) so two brands do not share one voice.
notes: One card for all five palettes: a palette is one value of the scorer's config (palette) and shares all code, so five cards would repeat the same files. The source url is a placeholder (OWNER) until the repository is published. Builtin: a command of this CLI; add only records it in the studio.
